description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - badge reader: aim at the name badge of the person in front of you, take a telephoto photo, and READ sends the photo to the host language model as a data: URL image (the official read-text path - there is no OCR and no face recognition), returning NAME / ORG / TITLE, spoken quietly to the wearer at once. DICT lets you dictate the name as YOU read it as a literal cross-check - MATCH or DIFF, your version wins - and SAVE registers the person against the head heading of that moment (text only, on this device). Face that direction again for 2 s while the agent is open and the name card pops back with a whisper: people are matched by DIRECTION, never by face
name: badge-reader
